title: Teaching himself drums; brother's age
summary: Ernie picked up drums without lessons. His brother, the oldest in the family, was about eighteen years older and played in short pants with Bunk Johnson.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Getting my first drums, with or without lessons

blocks.x: Can you tell us about your first drums when you started to take it up? Did you have any lessons? Did your brother help you with it or did you just pick it up?
No, I just actually picked it up. It was in me and I just picked it up.
About how much older was your brother than you?
Oh, he's the oldest one in the family. Right now he would be about 63. No, he would be about 68 right now.
How much older than you is that then?
He's 50 that day. I made 50 Sunday.
Oh, you're dead? Yeah. 18 years older than you. 18 years older than that.
Yeah, because when he was playing with Bung Johnson then he was in short pants. Of course you couldn't tell it because he's sitting behind the bass drum. Yeah. And you have a picture of that band?
